name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-bahrain

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search Bahrain government open data for datasets by keyword (population, census, education, GDP, labor market, industry). Returns dataset_ids (pass to query/dataset_info), titles and record counts.

query.description: Keyword(s) to search dataset titles/descriptions, e.g. "population".

tools.name: dataset_info
tools.description: Get metadata for one Bahrain government open data dataset (field schema, record count, description) — call before query to learn the column names.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Query records from a Bahrain government open data dataset with ODSQL. Filter (where), aggregate (group_by/select), sort (order_by), paginate (limit/offset).

select.description: ODSQL select/aggregation, e.g. `count(*) as n, sum(amount)`.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-bahrain forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-bahrain pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
